cards.name: Cruel Feeding
cards.oracleText:
Strive — This spell costs {2}{B} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
Any number of target creatures each get +1/+0 and gain lifelink until end of turn. (Damage dealt by a creature with lifelink also causes its controller to gain that much life.)

cards.name: Cruel Somnophage // Can't Wake Up
cards.oracleText:
Cruel Somnophage's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in all graveyards.
Target player mills four cards. (Then exile this card. You may cast the creature later from exile.)

cards.name: Cruel Celebrant
cards.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another creature or planeswalker you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Cruel Revival
cards.oracleText: Destroy target non-Zombie creature. It can't be regenerated. Return up to one target Zombie card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Cruel Entertainment
cards.oracleText: Choose target player and another target player. The first player controls the second player during the second player's next turn, and the second player controls the first player during the first player's next turn.

cards.name: Cruelclaw's Heist
cards.oracleText:
Gift a card (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they draw a card before its other effects.)
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card. If the gift was promised, you may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast it.

cards.name: Cruel Grimnarch
cards.oracleText:
Deathtouch
When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card. For each opponent who can't, you gain 4 life.

cards.name: Cruel Witness
cards.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

cards.name: Cruel Sadist
cards.oracleText:
{B}, {T}, Pay 1 life: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
{2}{B}, {T}, Remove X +1/+1 counters from this creature: It deals X damage to target creature.

cards.name: Cruel Deceiver
cards.oracleText:
{1}: Look at the top card of your library.
{2}: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, this creature gains "Whenever this creature deals damage to a creature, destroy that creature" until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Cruel Reality
cards.oracleText:
Enchant player
At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice. If the player can't, they lose 5 life.

cards.name: Cruel Ultimatum
cards.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice, discards three cards, then loses 5 life. You return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand, draw three cards, then gain 5 life.

cards.name: Cruel Edict
cards.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.

cards.name: Cruel Finality
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

cards.name: Tasigur's Cruelty
cards.oracleText:
Delve (Each card you exile from your graveyard while casting this spell pays for {1}.)
Each opponent discards two cards.

cards.name: Cruel Bargain
cards.oracleText: Draw four cards. You lose half your life, rounded up.

cards.name: Ob Nixilis's Cruelty
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

cards.name: Cruel Cut
cards.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 2 or less.

cards.name: Cruel Administrator
cards.oracleText:
Raid — This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if you attacked this turn.
Whenever this creature attacks, create a 2/2 red Soldier creature token with firebending 1. (Whenever it attacks, add {R}. This mana lasts until end of combat.)

cards.name: Cruel Fate
cards.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of target opponent's library. Put one of those cards into that player's graveyard and the rest on top of their library in any order.

cards.name: Cruel Truths
cards.oracleText: Surveil 2, then draw two cards. You lose 2 life. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

cards.name: Cruel Tutor
cards.oracleText: Search your library for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top. You lose 2 life.
